scope: Kandasa and all future executivesaudi cards until Khalid explicitly approves a brand change.

instruction: Reuse the approved Kandasa layout with dishwasher reference colors. Do not reuse Amal colors or earlier Kandasa variants.

reference.authority: User supplied dishwasher card is the color reference; latest approved Kandasa is the layout reference.

canvas.export_note: 1080x1920 is the previously requested publishing target, not the measured preview dimensions. Export without redesign and verify before upload.

palette.body_and_bullets: Match the blue of the pinned visual master.

palette.measurement_note: Previous median-sampled hex values are revoked, not approved brand tokens. Original editable color/font tokens have not been recovered. Do not claim exact matching from approximate sampling or a generation prompt.

layout.header: Green brand upper right with short green line; circular blue logo upper left.
layout.title: Red, preferably one readable line.
layout.photo: Actual sourced image, rounded panel, gray caption. No invented historical photo.
layout.body: Saudi colloquial Arabic without vowel marks, blue bullets, clear uniform large font matched visually to reference.
layout.font_note: Exact font family is not identified from raster. Never claim exact font identity without original font/template.
layout.closing: Red directly on ivory, no solid red banner.
layout.cta: Pale pink rounded strip, red arrow, text: شاركها مع صديقك اللي تعجبه هذي المعلومة.

qa: Preserve the master brand elements, logo, color roles and layout; do not regenerate or reinterpret the identity for each story.
If the reference is unavailable, stop design work rather than substitute a remembered palette.
Only story text and relevant photos may vary routinely; brand changes require Khalid's explicit approval.
Read this specification and open reference image before every new card.
Lock approved wording; edit only the requested elements.
Inspect actual output pixel dimensions, not prompt claims.
Compare actual text colors against reference; generated similarity is not exact color enforcement.
Keep text away from edges; no overlap, excessive gaps, or unreadable reduction.
No publication without explicit approval and verified posting checks.
